review.rawClauseInterface: CoverRawThirdKindReciprocity states exactly the existing fully quantified raw third-kind geometric clause. Naming this clause separately prevents cumulative elaboration of the long source signature from exceeding existing limits. The conditional theorem still consumes it as a named hypothesis and performs the actual correction/principality deduction.

discharged: The actual cover compact maximum principle proves vanishing of real period annihilators; integer coordinates then prove period-matrix injectivity directly, without a real period basis, discreteness or freeness. Native finite matrix correction and the actual integral laws subtract a regular differential preserving residues and producing integral periods on all avoiding loops. Together with prescribed residues and integral-period principality this proves the conditional Abel converse from the explicit raw geometric loop-generation and bilinear/third-kind reciprocity clauses. CoverRawThirdKindReciprocity only states its still-unproved geometric input; it is not an existence theorem. The geometric clauses, unconditional Abel converse and actual point division remain open.
